name: garminops
description: Garmin development connector: read data, manage workouts and calendar plans, and update current heart-rate, power and display-unit settings. Logged data is immutable.

interface.longDescription: Desktop local development plugin with 125 read adapters, Garmin account identity/status, and 24 named plan/settings writes. International MCP roundtrips verified for documented capabilities. One active region follows successful local login. FTHR null restoration is accepted known issue KI-001; further attempts are stopped. China business validation and Connect+ features are deferred TODOs. Other ordinary capabilities remain in development.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my Garmin connector status before reading my data. Never change logged data.
